items.title: Ernie Cagnolatti Interview, 1961-04-05
items.q: Raymond Burke tells about it. He used to play on it sometimes too.

ctx.x: I never played on it. I remember I never played on it. I never played on it. I played from outside, you know, private parties and big doctors on the big yachts and I stayed a long time on the Mazzinville. Then I left Mazzinville and then I went on the Susquehanna.
Yeah, so Wooden Joe I know used to play on it. I think you used to have a white band on it too. Raymond Burke tells about it. He used to play on it sometimes too.
Oh, business was good then, man. Sometimes people be standing at the walk waiting for you to land.
